faq_heading: Coquitlam West houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Coquitlam West. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Coquitlam West, Coquitlam: 64 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 6 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 1 of 23 Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Coquitlam West fell from 85 in June to 64 in October (−24.7%), and 19 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 16.9% of Coquitlam’s 378 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Coquitlam West?
Coquitlam West also had 353 condos and townhomes listed and 44 sold in October, against 64 houses listed. The Coquitlam West condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Coquitlam West home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

37 houses sold in Coquitlam West with a median price of $1,650,000 (the middle half sold between $1,544,000 and $1,918,000), taking a median of 36 days to sell at 95.7% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $649 per square foot, a median year built of 1966 and a median lot of 8,732 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Coquitlam West?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 64 houses listed in Coquitlam West. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Coquitlam West a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Coquitlam West had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Coquitlam West from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 19 houses sold in Coquitlam West over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Coquitlam West?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Coquitlam West sell for?
faq.a: 37 houses sold in Coquitlam West between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,650,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Coquitlam West?
faq.a: The median was 36 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.7% of the last list price (5% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
